title: Musetta!
subtitle: Musetta brings in the dying Mimì, who is with Rodolfo again, and sends Marcello to sell her earrings for medicine and a doctor while she goes for a muff, La bohème, Act 4

passages.label: Marcello: Musetta!; C'è Mimì (Allegro moderato agitato): Mimì could not manage the last stairs; Rodolfo runs to her
Meno molto: they carry her to the bed; Rodolfo! ... O mio Rodolfo! Mi vuoi qui con te? ((13)); Ah! mia Mimì, sempre!; Musetta: Intesi dire che Mimì...
(14) Andante mesto: Musetta's story: she found Mimì in the street, Voglio morir con lui!; (15) Mi sento assai meglio; Che ci avete in casa? Nulla!; Fra mezz'ora è morta
Ho tanto freddo! Se avessi un manicotto!; (16) Lento: Qui, nelle mie!; Ho un po' di tosse; Buon giorno Marcello, Schaunard, Colline; Tutti qui, sorridenti a Mimì
(17) Allegretto mosso: Marcello, date retta: è assai buona Musetta (Andante); Musetta's earrings: A te, vendi, ... manda un dottore! (Allegretto mosso); Tu non mi lasci? No! no!
(18) a tempo: Ascolta! Forse è l'ultima volta; Pel manicotto io vo. Con te verrò.; Marcello: Sei buona, o mia Musetta

licences.source: Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa, libretto of La bohème (1896)
licences.author: Luigi Illica (1857–1919) and Giuseppe Giacosa (1847–1906)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Ricordi vocal score.

licences.source: G. Ricordi & C. vocal score of La bohème, pages 247-257 (from page 247 system 3 bar 4, Marcello's “Mu-” as Musetta appears in the doorway, to the last bar of page 257, 107 bars; the first bar is the last bar of the previous piece's music, before the double bar)
licences.author: Carlo Carignani (1857–1919), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. Rodolfo's part is printed in the treble clef and written here at sounding pitch. Marcello's spoken “Sst” (bar 47), printed with a stem and flag but no notehead, is written with a cross notehead. No metronome mark is printed in this scene: the first bar keeps the previous piece's closing tempo, and the Allegro moderato agitato, Meno molto, Andante mesto at figure (14), Lento at figure (16), Allegretto mosso at figure (17) and Andante (bar 83) carry no number and are values chosen as stated in the piece's notes; the second Allegretto mosso (bar 87) is the same heading restated.
